notes.title: FREE！
notes.notes:
HELLO！

This game will be free around February 10, 2023.

The reason is also very simple, I recovered the cost of the game and G fat deducted my deposit.
Games are a tool used to create joy, and while my game sucks, it shouldn't leave players to measure between money and games. So I will do the same for future games, free after recouping the cost of development.

Free has no effect on players who haven't purchased yet. For players who purchase at the offer price and 50% of the offer price, you can send me a receipt by email, and I will send you a CDK after the release of my new game。

I love you. This is my email.
2275445370@qq.com

notes.title: 22/7/2021 Update announcement
notes.notes:
Optimized the gaming experience
1: Increase the player's running speed from 700 to 900
2. Optimize the action of some female ghosts
3. Increase the moving speed of most female ghosts and strengthen the sense of oppression
4: You can change level. Press P in the game to play the extra level.

notes.title: 21/7/2021 Update announcement
notes.notes:
I am very sorry to give the players a bad game experience. I made a small update according to the evaluation of some players, and other problems not mentioned will be improved in the subsequent update.
1. adjusted the frequency of camera shaking
2. Fixed the bug of female ghost stuck
3. The brightness of the basic flashlight is improved, and the modes of highlighting, super-bright and blinking are added
4: Temporarily removed the plot
5: Add key tips
